verdict.rationale: Steel is a cloud browser API and infrastructure product that agents consume. It does not run its own agent loop, so plugging MCP servers into it as a tool-consuming client is a category error for this product type. The MCP evidence ([steel-docs-9], [steel-docs-46]) shows Steel in the opposite, server-side role: it exposes its browser as MCP tools to other clients. That does not make the client axis applicable.
